'''Gemmapo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Lilypo]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Whether the world turns to ruins or a giant heap of trash, it's still a one-of-a-kind film set for Gemmapo. After all, a bleak backdrop is perfect for making the colors pop. Oh, here comes the breeze. Hold down that skirt, and stay fabulous."

Gemmapo is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A bipedal hippopotamus that wears an elegant, pink skirt with pearls. Its body is brown with a lighter brown underside. Its ears are tied together with a purple hair tie, creating a heart shape. It also seems to be wearing pink lipstick and its eyes are squeezed shut. Its hooves are also pink and heart-shaped.

Gemmapo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its pink skirt to purple, and its body becomes reddish-brown instead of brown.

== Trivia ==
* Gemmapo and its evolutions were added to the game on 6/3/2026 alongside [[Cosmoram]] and [[Heliabloom]].
